anchors.paper_title: A resource for assessing information processing in the developing brain using EEG and eye tracking
anchors.reason: Langer et al. 2017 describes a separate 126-participant EEG/eye-tracking dataset (ages 6-44), not the HBN-EEG release; topically related but not this dataset's data paper.

anchors.paper_venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
anchors.reason: Zenodo record "HBN-EEG NC - BIDS Dataset" has the same authors and describes the non-commercial HBN-EEG release; it is another deposit of this dataset (IsIdenticalTo).

metadata.methods_description: EEG data were collected during various cognitive and behavioral tasks from HBN participants. Behavioral responses including reaction times and accuracy were recorded concurrently with EEG acquisition. Events are annotated using Hierarchical Event Descriptors (HED version 8.3.0) to enable systematic meta-analysis. Quality control procedures verified data integrity, task completeness, and preprocessing readiness.
